items.exampleZh: 有些小孩覺得打雷很可怕。

items.exampleEn: You look ridiculous in that giant hat.
items.exampleZh: 你戴那頂大帽子看起來好荒謬。

items.exampleEn: The school is looking for talented students to join the band.
items.exampleZh: 學校正在找有才華的學生加入樂團。

items.exampleEn: The old palace still shows the glory of the past.
items.exampleZh: 那座古老的宮殿仍展現著昔日的榮耀。

items.exampleEn: My mom is always calm, even in an emergency.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽總是很冷靜，即使遇到緊急狀況也一樣。

items.exampleEn: Don't let one bad grade discourage you.
items.exampleZh: 別讓一次考不好讓你洩氣。

items.sentenceEn: Hopefully, the bus won't be late today.
items.sentenceZh: 但願今天公車不會誤點。

items.audioEn: The sea was calm this morning, so we went out in a small boat.
items.audioZh: 今天早上海面很平靜，所以我們搭小船出海。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼能搭小船出海？
options: It was early in the morning.
A friend lent them a boat.

items.sentenceEn: He was talented at drawing even as a child.
items.sentenceZh: 他從小就很有繪畫天分。

items.sentenceEn: The rule sounds ridiculous to me.
items.sentenceZh: 這條規定在我聽來很荒謬。

items.stemEn: The dark forest at night was really ____; my little brother cried.
items.stemZh: 夜晚漆黑的森林真的很可怕，我弟弟都哭了。

items.stemEn: The rain didn't ____ us from going hiking.
items.stemZh: 這場雨沒有讓我們打消去健行的念頭。

items.passageEn: Last month, my friend Amy took part in a city swimming race. She is a talented swimmer, but she was nervous. "It's scary to swim in front of so many people," she said. I told her to stay calm and enjoy it. Some kids laughed at her ridiculous swimming cap with a big flower on it, but she didn't let them discourage her. When the race started, she swam beautifully. Her last turn was unbelievable. In the end, she won first prize and enjoyed her moment of glory. One boy who lost the race left in a rage, but later he said sorry. Hopefully, Amy will swim in the race again next year.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我的朋友 Amy 參加了全市的游泳比賽。她是一位很有天分的泳者，但她很緊張。她說：「在這麼多人面前游泳好可怕。」我叫她保持冷靜，好好享受。有些小孩笑她那頂上面有一朵大花的荒謬泳帽，但她沒讓他們打擊她的信心。比賽一開始，她就表現得非常出色。她最後一個轉身令人難以置信。最後，她得了第一名，享受了屬於她的榮耀時刻。一個比賽輸了的男生怒氣沖沖地離開，但後來他道歉了。希望 Amy 明年還會參加這場比賽。

options: 前一天晚上完全沒有時間練習
擔心比賽那天的水會太冷
在很多人面前游泳很可怕
她的泳鏡在比賽前弄壞了

questions.questionZh: 輸了比賽的男生後來怎麼做？
options: 跟老師告狀說比賽不公平

referenceEn: Hopefully, it will be sunny tomorrow.
rubricZh: hopefully 表示「但願、希望」，例如 Hopefully, … 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說未來的事用 will、be going to 等）

items.promptZh: 這位年輕的廚師非常有才華。
referenceEn: This young cook is very talented.
The young cook is extremely talented.
rubricZh: 用 talented 表示「有才華的」
